template_instructions.doc_name_local: Pregnancy Follow-up Information and Consent Form – Pregnant Participant
template_instructions.description: Must be used when the study involves collection of pregnancy outcome, maternal-health or infant-health information from a pregnant trial participant.
footer: Protocol number: [fill in] | EU trial number: [fill in]
info_table: Data Protection Officer [name and contact details]
template_instructions.content_instructions: Use only for pregnancy follow-up of a trial participant who becomes pregnant during the trial or protocol-defined exposure period. This document supplements the original trial consent. Cover only pregnancy-specific purpose and risks, consequences for study treatment, minimum maternal/pregnancy/outcome and applicable infant data, sources and follow-up period, contact with healthcare professionals, relevant biological samples/genetic testing only if actually planned, focused data handling and withdrawal, and applicable consent choices. Include explicit consent for processing health-research data as the default for a capable person; remove it only where an approved Irish alternative or consent-declaration route applies. Required follow-up activities belong in the Required acknowledgements list with an individual confirmation checkbox; use Yes/No only for genuinely optional activities. Do not repeat general trial information or include secondary/future use. Add the conditional under-16 assent/parental-consent block only for trials that accept minors.
template_instructions.styling_instructions: Use clear participant-facing question headings and short sections. Use a clean readable font such as Calibri, Arial, Verdana or Tahoma at about 12 point. Avoid block capitals and unnecessary legalistic text. Use tables or simple flow charts when they improve understanding. Present required acknowledgements as a clear list with one checkbox beside each applicable acknowledgement and the final dated signature. Do not use Yes/No choices or initials for required acknowledgements. Use Yes/No choices only for genuinely optional components. Where optional components are included, present their confirmation/signature separately from the main consent signature. Use separate fields for printed name, date and signature.

template_content.section_content: Pregnancy follow-up information Drafting note: Use this adult/capable form for a pregnant person aged 16 or older who can consent. If the pregnant participant is under 16, use an age-appropriate assent plus parent/guardian consent pathway. You became pregnant during the clinical trial or within the protocol-defined period after study treatment/exposure. This document asks for your consent to collect information about your pregnancy and its outcome for safety follow-up. This consent is separate from your original trial consent. It does not by itself decide whether you continue or stop the investigational medicine or other main-trial procedures; those decisions follow the protocol and medical assessment.
template_content.section_style: H2 document subline, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: Why are we collecting pregnancy information? Explain what is known and unknown about the investigational medicine/intervention and pregnancy, why pregnancy outcomes are collected, and how the information contributes to safety evaluation. Use relevant human/non-clinical information only when it helps the pregnant person understand risk.
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: What does the pregnancy mean for the main trial? Explain whether the investigational medicine must be stopped/interrupted, whether unblinding may be needed, what pregnancy-related safety monitoring is required, and what usual clinical care continues. If continued experimental exposure during pregnancy is permitted, explain this separately and ensure the approved protocol supports it.
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: What are the known or possible risks? Describe known, suspected and uncertain risks to the pregnant participant, embryo/fetus and child, and relevant consequences of stopping or continuing study treatment. Explain any additional tests or monitoring and their risks.
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: What information will be collected? List the pregnancy/maternal-health data, relevant investigational-product exposure and concomitant medicines, pregnancy course, outcome and any agreed infant information. State sources: participant, trial records, relevant medical records, obstetrician/maternity hospital or other named healthcare professionals. Access must be limited to information relevant to pregnancy follow-up.
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: How long will follow-up last and who may be contacted? State the exact follow-up period and timepoints. Explain whether the study team will contact the participant directly and whether the obstetrician/midwife/GP/maternity hospital will be contacted. Drafting note: If the obstetrician or other healthcare professional will be contacted or relevant pregnancy records accessed, include the corresponding explicit consent item below.
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: Will any samples or genetic tests be collected? Drafting note: Pregnancy follow-up is often data-only. Remove this section if no biological samples or genetic/genomic testing are collected specifically for pregnancy follow-up. If samples are collected, state what, how much, why, when, whether required or optional, coding, storage, laboratories/recipients, transfers and what happens after analysis. If genetic/genomic testing is done, explain its type/purpose, whether required or optional, privacy/family risks, incidental/individual findings, counselling, storage/security and transfers. Do not include secondary/future research in this document.
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: What happens to your pregnancy information? Explain controllers, purposes, coding/linkage with the participant’s trial data, recipients, relevant direct record access, security, retention, international transfers and safeguards, rights, Data Protection Officer and complaint route. Explain any legally required continued safety processing after withdrawal in simple terms.
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: Is pregnancy follow-up voluntary and can you withdraw? Participation in pregnancy follow-up is voluntary. Refusal or withdrawal does not reduce ordinary medical care. Explain the effect on the main trial separately. State what happens to already collected pregnancy information and samples and what new collection will stop.
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: What about information about the baby after birth? If the study collects identifiable health information about the child after birth, describe the exact information and follow-up period and use a separate post-birth parent/guardian consent section or document as required. Do not assume that consent given during pregnancy automatically covers the child’s own post-birth personal data.
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: Costs, reimbursement, results and contacts State any pregnancy-follow-up costs/reimbursement, whether individual or overall safety information will be communicated, sponsor/site contacts, obstetric/urgent contact where appropriate, Data Protection Officer and complaint route.
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text

template_content.section_content: CONSENT TO PREGNANCY FOLLOW-UP Required acknowledgements Drafting note: Keep only statements that apply. Delete non-applicable conditional statements. Do not use Yes/No choices or initials for required acknowledgements. Place one confirmation checkbox beside each applicable required acknowledgement. By signing below, I confirm that: ☐ I have read and understood the pregnancy follow-up information, had time to decide and had my questions answered. ☐ I voluntarily agree to the collection and use of my pregnancy and maternal-health information for the pregnancy safety follow-up described. [Default – include for a capable participant unless an approved Irish alternative/consent-declaration route applies] ☐ I give explicit consent for my health data to be processed for the pregnancy follow-up described. ☐ I agree that my pregnancy follow-up information may be linked with my coded clinical-trial information as described. [Conditional – contact with obstetrician/other healthcare professional] ☐ I agree that the study investigator may contact [my obstetrician/midwife/GP/maternity hospital] to obtain information relevant to my pregnancy and its outcome as described. [Conditional – required relevant medical-record access] ☐ I agree to the required study-related access to the relevant pregnancy/medical records described. [Conditional – required pregnancy-follow-up sample] ☐ I agree to the required [sample] described for pregnancy follow-up. [Conditional – required genetic/genomic testing] ☐ I agree to the required genetic/genomic testing described for pregnancy follow-up. [Conditional – other required pregnancy-follow-up activity] ☐ [INSERT REQUIRED STUDY-SPECIFIC ACKNOWLEDGEMENT].

template_content.section_content: Optional pregnancy-follow-up choices You may answer “No” to any choice below and still take part in the remainder of the pregnancy follow-up. Drafting note: Include only genuinely optional components that can be refused without preventing the pregnancy follow-up. [Conditional – optional sample/test] I agree to the optional [sample/test]. Yes ☐ No ☐ [Conditional – optional genetic/genomic testing] I agree to the optional genetic/genomic testing. Yes ☐ No ☐ [Conditional – include when one or more optional choices are present] Confirmation of optional choices I confirm that the optional choices marked above reflect the decisions recorded for this follow-up. Name of person confirming optional choices: ____________________ Role (participant / parent or guardian, as applicable): ____________________ Date: __________ Signature: ____________________
template_content.section_style: H3 module title, Rich body text, Checkbox group, Signature section

template_content.section_content: [Conditional – post-birth infant safety follow-up] Drafting note: Use only after the child is born and only when identifiable infant health information is collected as part of protocol-defined pregnancy safety follow-up. Obtain consent from the appropriate parent/guardian; do not rely solely on consent given before birth. Keep only applicable required statements. Do not use Yes/No choices or initials for required statements; place one confirmation checkbox beside each applicable statement. By signing below, I confirm that: ☐ I have received information about the infant follow-up, including what information will be collected, from whom and for how long. ☐ I consent to collection and use of my child’s health information for the infant safety follow-up described. [Conditional – contact with child’s healthcare professional] ☐ I agree that the study team may contact my child’s [paediatrician/GP/hospital] for the infant information described. Parent/guardian name: ____________________ Relationship: ____________________ Date: __________ Signature: ____________________

template_content.section_content: Signatures Pregnant participant name: ____________________ Date: __________ Signature: ____________________ Person taking consent: ____________________ Role/qualification: ____________________ Date: __________ Signature: ____________________ A signed copy should be provided to the pregnant participant. [Conditional – include only for trials that accept minors and where the pregnant participant is under 16] Assent and parent/guardian consent Drafting note: Use this block for an under-16 pregnant participant. The participant gives assent; the parent/guardian provides the legally effective consent. Do not treat the participant’s assent signature as legal consent. When this block applies, adapt the standard signature pathway above accordingly. Assent The pregnancy follow-up has been explained to me in a way I can understand. I have been able to ask questions. I agree to the pregnancy follow-up described above and know I can say I want to stop.
